profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Qualia | Ex-Amazon | MSCS & MBA | Full-Stack
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with over 12 years of experience building scalable, user-focused applications: from legacy monoliths to mobile first platforms serving hundreds of thousands of users.

At Amazon, I’ve led major initiatives in the AtoZ app ecosystem: building native test automation infrastructure from scratch; eliminating manual QA dependencies; improving  performance at scale, and mentoring engineers through onboarding and promotions. I enjoy creating tools and systems that not only work, but last.

My technical strengths span frontend architecture (React, React Native, GraphQL), test automation (Appium, WebdriverIO), and CI/CD enablement for fast, reliable deployments. I thrive at the intersection of usability, performance, and developer experience.

I’m also an Oracle- and AWS-certified developer, with additional training in system architecture, functional programming, and data science. I stay curious and constantly look for ways to improve; not just the code, but the systems, processes, and people around it.

I hold a Master’s in Computer Science from Georgia Tech with a focus on Machine Learning, an MBA in Finance, and a Bachelor's in Electronics & Communications Engineering.

Outside of work, you’ll find me wrangling code, ideas, and sometimes toddlers.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Led frontend architecture, test infrastructure, and international feature delivery for Amazon's AtoZ platform, a React/React Native app used by 1.2M+ associates for shift scheduling, pay, and time-off. Live apps served 50k to 300k concurrent users.

• Built native test automation from scratch using WebdriverIO, Appium, and AWS Device Farm. Created a test harness app with mocked network conditions for parallelized iOS/Android execution. Eliminated daily manual QA and enabled full CI/CD for native releases. Later created a shared test utilities library and migrated the suite to TypeScript.
• Led the Paid VTO feature across web and native from initial build (UK/Ireland) through expansion to France. Architected a reworked API call pattern to solve downstream timeout issues. 80+ code reviews shipped across 3 years.
• Led the frontend migration from a legacy portal to a micro-frontend architecture. Created dual build configs, built the data abstraction layer, instrumented framework-aware metrics, and managed rollback during production traffic spikes.
• Authored the technical design for the Shift Auction feature. Led a 3-engineer team through implementation.
• Built 20+ React Native components for Time and Attendance, extracting shared hooks for cross-platform reuse. Set up the Expo dev environment and native Storybook.
• Built the CloudWatch monitoring stack for the native app: 57 alarms, 5 dashboards, cross-account log sharing and IAM roles.
• Managed feature flag rollouts for expansion across 10+ countries. Led a service migration covering ~62K associates across 995 sites.
• Mentored an apprentice (converted to full-time), a return-offer intern, and onboarded 5+ engineers.

Tech: React, React Native, TypeScript, GraphQL, Appium, WebdriverIO, Cypress, AWS (CDK, CloudWatch, Device Farm, Lambda)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Joined the AtoZ Shift Management team and grew from individual contributor to leading cross-team feature delivery, earning promotion to SDE II.

• One of the founding engineers on a ground-up rewrite of the scheduling app as a React/TypeScript monorepo with GraphQL and a shared component library across web and mobile. 3rd most active committer on a 10-engineer team.
• Led the Pay Breakdown feature end-to-end: identified data sources, coordinated with upstream teams on API access and data security, designed fallback UI for incomplete data, and shipped across backend (Java Lambda) and frontend (React).
• Identified a GraphQL resolver bottleneck causing ~5s blocked time on page navigation. Authored a technical findings doc, proposed the migration strategy, and delivered the refactor. Dashboard p95 latency improved by over 20%.
• Designed the schema changes that enabled the platform's first international expansion to the UK (~52,800 associates). Coordinated the rollout across 4 teams with zero rollbacks.
• Created 55+ Cypress E2E tests covering all major user flows, enabling the team to remove the manual approval step from the deployment pipeline.
• Re-enabled all previously disabled integration tests and integrated them into the CI/CD pipeline, replacing manual QA gates.
• Owned the full Gamma stage deployment across 4 packages, resolving CloudFormation stack issues, pipeline configuration, and API routing.

Tech: React, React Native, TypeScript, GraphQL, Java, AWS Lambda, Cypress, Storybook

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Lead contributor on the TxEIS platform for Educational Service Center, Region 20, a system used by public school districts across Texas.

• Led interpretation and implementation of new state and federal legislation within TxEIS, ensuring ongoing platform compliance for school districts.
• Designed and maintained core backend systems, applying clean architecture principles and efficient data access patterns to reduce technical debt.
• Authored technical specifications and internal documentation. Facilitated training sessions for ESC consultants to enable smooth feature rollouts.
• Collaborated with consultants and support staff to translate requirements into reliable, user-aligned features.

Tech: Java, SQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript

positions.title: Application Development Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Worked across billing and account management applications for Charter Communications. Led offshore development efforts and owned revenue-critical systems.

• Tech lead for the offshore team delivering the Voice Online Manager (VOM) platform, aligning design, implementation, and delivery across time zones.
• Owned full-stack development of the Legacy-TWC Online Bill Payment system, a revenue-critical application processing high-volume payments.
• Designed and implemented backend logic for user account management, billing workflows, and transaction processing using Java, Groovy, and Scala.
• Built and deployed RESTful and SOAP web services within microservices and 3-tier MVC architectures.
• Owned production support and root-cause analysis using Splunk for log tracing and dashboard creation. Deployed via Jenkins and AWS/Asgard CI/CD pipelines.

Tech: Java, Spring, REST, SOAP, Groovy, Scala, AWS, Splunk, Jenkins
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to the development and maintenance of Mexico's .MX domain registry, registrar portal, and electronic invoicing system. Focused on stable, maintainable backend systems.

• Designed and implemented enhancements for domain registration and billing systems serving the national .MX registry.
• Integrated REST and SOAP web services using CXF and standard SOA patterns into internal applications.
• Developed SQL queries and service-layer logic for transaction handling and data validation.
• Supported performance tuning by reviewing query plans and contributed to build/deployment processes using Ant and Maven.

Tech: Java, JSF, JDBC, SQL, REST, SOAP, Maven, Ant
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaServer Faces (JSF) · SQL · REST APIs

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Joined through Infosys's Foundation Program, an intensive training in Java, Oracle, and Unix systems, then transitioned to full-time project work on internal enterprise applications and L3 mobile support.

• Built data-driven features for an internal enterprise application using JSF and JPA, handling both frontend and backend components.
• Provided L3 support for a CRM application running on Android devices, conducting root-cause analysis and creating documentation for L1/L2 teams.
• Performed functional testing and bug resolution across the application stack.

Tech: Java, JSF, JPA, HTML/CSS, Eclipse, Tomcat, Unix

positions.title: Internships
positions.description:
Completed internships across telecommunications, automotive testing, and enterprise networking in Mexico and Germany.

• Last Mile Engineer – Alestra: Coordinated planned maintenance for internal telecom systems and provided on-site troubleshooting during network incidents.
• Test Engineer – P3 Group (Stuttgart, Germany): Developed test cases and executed HMI and stress testing on automotive telematics and infotainment systems for premium vehicle brands.
• Telecommunications Intern – Arnecom Industrias: Participated in a network infrastructure upgrade, diagnosed daily connectivity issues, and documented resolutions for future operations.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Supported students in identifying and preparing for international internship opportunities through AIESEC's global network. Coordinated with international partner committees to match candidates with relevant programs, provided pre-departure guidance, and facilitated cultural preparation.

Engaged with students across local universities to promote global mobility and professional growth, while developing communication, cross-cultural, and organizational skills in a fast-paced, volunteer-driven environment.

projects.title: Comparative Analysis of Supervised Learning Algorithms
projects.description: mplemented and compared five supervised learning algorithms—Decision Trees, Neural Networks, Boosting, Support Vector Machines, and k-Nearest Neighbors—using Python and scikit-learn. Conducted experiments on two UCI datasets (Adult Income and Car Evaluation) involving preprocessing, one-hot encoding, normalization, and cross-validation. Tuned hyperparameters via grid search and evaluated models using accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and runtime metrics. Analyzed performance trade-offs, overfitting, and scalability across models

projects.title: Content-Aware Seam Carving for Image Resizing
projects.description: Reimplemented the Content-Aware Seam Carving algorithm introduced by Avidan and Shamir (2007) to perform intelligent image resizing while preserving key visual content. Built from scratch in Python using OpenCV and NumPy, replicating both the original and improved (2008) methods. Implemented backward and forward energy functions with Sobel operators and dynamic programming to identify and remove low-energy seams. Successfully reproduced the original research results and analyzed pixel-level differences to evaluate performance and artifacts
